notes.title: German Language Available!
notes.notes:
Now Deputinization has the German language! Thanks to our player Klesk 🌈 Нептун 🇺🇦 for translating!

Glory to Ukraine!

notes.title: We need your reviews!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Do you like our game? Please, leave your review on our steam page. It will help us to promote the game. 

Thanks a lot for your support!

notes.title: Deputinization is now available
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who supported our project. And the day has come, when we finally release the game.

But this is not all news. After the release, our main developer stands in defense of Ukraine in the Territorial Defense. So by buying the game, you support not only indie developers but also the Ukrainian army.

Glory to Ukraine!

notes.title: Fixing little bugs
notes.notes:
We are working on small bugs right now to be ready for release. 

There is very little time left before the release. We will do our best to make you enjoy playing

notes.title: Deputinization coming 30th September
notes.notes:
We are ready to announce the release date of the game! And it will be September 30.

We are glad that you are with us. The last step remains!

Glory to Heroes!

notes.title: Happy Independence Day of Ukraine.
notes.notes:
Happy Independence Day of Ukraine. Thanks to our soldiers that we can celebrate this day. Glory to Ukraine!

And now we have a 1000 wishlist! Thanks everyone for your support!

notes.title: Ukrainian Games Festival!
notes.notes:
We invite you to visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2023]Ukrainian Games Festival 2023[/url], which will start today. There you will find not only our game but also interesting projects of other Ukrainian developers.

WELCOME!

notes.title: New Bayraktar Level is comming
notes.notes:
Right now I am working on the new Bayraktar level. Location of this level will be a road near moscow.

I think, after this level, I will start to prepare for release!

notes.title: Arcade Mode
notes.notes:
Right now I am working on Arcade mode for Deputinization.

It will like classic Arcade Machines. You will not be able to select a level. The levels will go one after the other and if you lose, you'll start over
